notes.title: Advanced Strategies Vol. 1
notes.content:
For all of you more seasoned prospectors, follow this technique to [b]lure particularly greedy prospectors into your traps.[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30591057/550822febc6372641ca2b6fd73ba90d5b1bb9c85.gif[/img]

[b]Step 1:[/b] Place bait near a plant or grass.
[b]Step 2:[/b] Place a bear trap in the grass (makes it harder to spot).
[b]Step 3:[/b] Wait for unsuspecting victim to appear.
[b]Step 4:[/b] Congratulations, you trapped a prospector! Now hit them with dynamite to take all their stuff!

notes.title: OH MY GOD HALLOWEEN SO HATS SCARY SCARY
notes.content:
[h1]Booohooo fellow gold seeking ghosts! ːsteamhappyː[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30591057/f60a96fd010709c1d08592d8837e114e34522fa5.gif[/img]
Recent studies have shown that GOLDRUSHING without proper headgear leaves you nugget-less and sad.

It is with the utmost haste that we have remedied this affliction of prospector’s ill fate.
[u]For your haunting we have supplied you with several new protective prospecting products:[/u]

[list]
    [*]CHICKEN
    [*]CAT
    [*]HORSE
    [*]GLASSES GUY
[/list]

What do they all have in common?
[spoiler]ABSOLUTELY NOTHING[/spoiler]

[b]Scary Prospecting ![/b]
[i]The Goldrushers Team[/i]

notes.title: Desert Level Updates
notes.content:
Hello Fellow prospectors!
Thank you so much for downloading GOLDRUSHERS! We have been using all of your feedback to make improvements over the last week!

[b]We have optimized performance in the Desert Level considerably.[/b] You should be able to prospect more smoothly in the searing heat!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30591057/81f2a85e4d1511188b883f7a06afbf2ee074e8dd.jpg[/img]
Keep checking back for more updates as we continue to improve the game!
The GOLDRUSHERS Team
